name: source-count-at-fixed-M
description: The central contrast of the research programme, in its smallest form. Total incoming share is held at 0.30 in every condition; only the number of source cultures varies. Scenario 1 (K=1) is one incoming culture at 30%; scenario 4 (K=10) is ten at 3% each. Identical migration magnitude, different cultural information environment. Under the v0.1 null transmission rule these conditions will differ ONLY in composition metrics, which is the point: that difference is the baseline any transmission result must exceed.
